scope: Read-only source/type audit; no game or ADB interaction; no runtime behavior inferred from empty method bodies.

findings.conclusion: No declared standard per-hit timestamp/event series in this surface. Opaque extraInfo/clientAntiCheatLog collections cannot be categorically ruled out by names alone.
Ranges, scalar totals, per-type totals, elemental totals/counts and CharacterSnapshot list. No native hit-event history list.
EnemySnapshot and EnemyRuntimeSnapshot are AntiCheat attribute snapshots, with maximum one snapshot per enemy key in declared constants; not complete enemy HP history.

Holds Journal plus pending/ready BattleLogger.LogItem operations. Journal has initial squad, random seed, rune list and operation log. Replay input is distinct from directly readable output-event history.

_CreateVerboseRecorder takes GameModeType; recorder has createOverride factory, isMultiLayerRecord property and GetLogDirPath. Type dump has empty method bodies, so exact enable condition cannot be established.
Besides m_detailLogs, recorder has FileLogger and BattleLog directory / BattleLog_{1}/B-{2}.log naming. Read-only filesystem discovery is worthwhile even when current recorder pointer is null.

Nodes exist for current play time, frame-count key and ModifierRealDelta. This is a potential mode-specific logging route, not evidence of a universal per-hit ledger. Need actual Android mappings and actual keys/content before use.
MultiplayerBattleLogMgr queues file upload references; GameActionHistoryRet carries multiplayer StepData; BattleLogCollector holds crisis runes. None establishes ordinary OF-2 per-hit recovery.

recommended_runtime_checks: Read confirmed Android Logger+0x38 at start, after known attacks, before battle exit; retain session/frame/guard for every result.
Read only game-owned app files/external-files paths for BattleLog or MultiBattleLog files, inspect format and coverage if present; do not enable recorders or debug flags.
Compare confirmed operation-log count/types before and after attacks with no player action; verify whether any new event type appears.

If inspecting extraBattleInfo/clientAntiCheatLog, first resolve Android field metadata; never transplant the PC offsets from this report. Treat special-node content as incomplete until timestamps/source/deltas and retention are verified.
If any actual event source is found, test a deliberate collector gap, long battle retention and session reset; reconcile against live observations.
bounded_conclusion: Known read-only cumulative counters plus operation journal do not directly determine unobserved hit timings. Current evidence does not support promising full event-history recovery. It also does not prove no other mode-specific, disk or opaque-collection path exists.
